group: Gundam Wing: Endless Waltz / Mobile Fighter G Gundam
note: Spellings checked against Gundam Wiki (gundam.fandom.com) page titles and redirects through the MediaWiki API on 2026-10-02. Unit page titles carry model numbers (e.g. 'OZ-06MS Leo'); ACE2 shows names without model numbers, so 'en' drops the model number. 'Game text' means the extracted ACE2 script in work/translation/en.

entries.series: Mobile Suit Gundam Wing / Endless Waltz
entries.role: Gundam pilot (Wing Gundam Zero); Preventer agent in the Endless Waltz era
entries.personality: Stoic, terse 'perfect soldier'; cold on the surface, ruthless on missions, protective of Relena.
entries.notes: Wiki page title 'Heero Yuy'. 'Heero' has no common variant spellings. It is a code name taken from the assassinated colony leader of the same name.

entries.ja: デュオ・マックスウェル
entries.series: Mobile Suit Gundam Wing / Endless Waltz
entries.role: Gundam pilot (Gundam Deathscythe Hell); calls himself the God of Death
entries.personality: Cheerful, talkative, jokey and casual; says he 'runs and hides but never lies'. Fierce in battle.
entries.notes: Wiki page title 'Duo Maxwell'. Alias 'God of Death' (死神, Shinigami).

entries.series: Mobile Suit Gundam Wing / Endless Waltz
entries.role: Gundam pilot (Gundam Heavyarms); mercenary and circus clown
entries.personality: Quiet, calm and emotionally reserved; speaks little and is loyal to his comrades, especially Quatre.
entries.notes: Wiki page title 'Trowa Barton'. This is an assumed name: the wiki gives his real name as Triton Bloom and an alias 'Nanashi / No-Name'. The game uses a half-width middle dot (･).

entries.ja: カトル・ラバーバ・ウィナー
entries.series: Mobile Suit Gundam Wing / Endless Waltz
entries.role: Gundam pilot (Gundam Sandrock); heir of the wealthy Winner family of the L4 colonies; commands the Maganac Corps
entries.personality: Kind, polite, empathetic pacifist and a reluctant soldier. Uses the soft first-person pronoun 'boku'. Also a capable strategist.
entries.notes: Wiki page title 'Quatre Raberba Winner' (romanized Katoru Rababa Wina). Keep 'Raberba', not 'Rababa'.

entries.series: Mobile Suit Gundam Wing / Endless Waltz
entries.role: Gundam pilot (Shenlong/Altron, called Nataku); sides with the Mariemaia Army in Endless Waltz and in ACE2's story before rejoining his comrades
entries.personality: Proud and honor-obsessed; obsessed with justice; despises weakness; prone to angry outbursts. In ACE2 he declares he will 'become evil' to test whether peace built on sacrifice is just.
entries.notes: Wiki page title 'Chang Wufei' (Japanese reading Chan Ufei; Mandarin pinyin Zhang Wufei). Variants seen elsewhere: 'Wu Fei', 'Chang Wu Fei', 'Wu-Fei'. 'Wu Fei' has no wiki page or redirect, so the one-word 'Wufei' is the standard. Family name first, as in the Japanese.

entries.series: Mobile Suit Gundam Wing / Endless Waltz
entries.role: Ace pilot (Tallgeese, Tallgeese III); former OZ officer and White Fang leader; Preventer agent ('Preventer Wind') in Endless Waltz. True identity Milliardo Peacecraft, Relena's older brother.
entries.personality: Proud, chivalrous and self-loathing; a brilliant pilot torn between knightly ideals and soldiering. Speaks with formal dignity.
entries.notes: Contested spelling. The wiki's main page title is his real name 'Milliardo Peacecraft'. 'Zechs Merquise' redirects to it and is the spelling the wiki and official English releases use for the alias. 'Zechs Marquise' is a common fan misspelling; the wiki redirects it to 'Zechs Merquise'. The game uses the alias ゼクス･マーキス, so use 'Zechs Merquise', not 'Milliardo Peacecraft'. 'Zechs' comes from German 'sechs' (six). His nickname 'the Lightning Count' (also translated 'Lightning Baron') is also contested.

entries.ja: ルクレツィア・ノイン
entries.series: Mobile Suit Gundam Wing / Endless Waltz
entries.role: Mobile suit pilot and former OZ Specials instructor; Preventer agent ('Preventer Fire'); Zechs's devoted partner. ACE2 calls her ノイン特尉 (Preventer rank).
entries.personality: Mature, composed, slightly tomboyish; an idealist who dislikes war, but fights hard for those she believes in. Fiercely loyal to Zechs.
entries.notes: Wiki page title 'Lucrezia Noin'. 'Lucretia' is a variant spelling to avoid. She prefers to be called 'Noin'. The rank 特尉 has no wiki-attested English form; 'Special Lieutenant' is a literal suggestion (low confidence). Her OZ-era rank on the wiki is First-Class Lieutenant.

entries.series: Mobile Fighter G Gundam
entries.role: Neo Japan Gundam Fighter (Shining Gundam, then God Gundam); King of Hearts and leader of the Shuffle Alliance
entries.personality: Hot-blooded, brash, impulsive and impatient; socially awkward, but has a strong sense of justice. Prone to loud battle cries.
entries.notes: Wiki page title 'Domon Kasshu' (also the English-dub spelling). Avoid 'Domon Kash'. Title: 'King of Hearts' (wiki alias field reads 'King of Heart').

entries.series: Mobile Suit Gundam Wing / Endless Waltz
entries.role: Mass-produced general-purpose mobile suit (OZ-06MS), also used by the Mariemaia Army
entries.notes: Wiki title 'OZ-06MS Leo'. In the game's unit_names.json.

entries.series: Mobile Suit Gundam Wing / Endless Waltz
entries.role: Mass-produced aerial mobile suit (OZ-07AMS)
entries.notes: Wiki title 'OZ-07AMS Aries' (romanized Earizu).

entries.series: Mobile Suit Gundam Wing / Endless Waltz
entries.role: Mass-produced AI-controlled mobile doll (OZ-02MD) with planet defensors
entries.notes: Wiki title 'OZ-02MD Virgo'. Not 'Bilgo' or 'Virgo II'. The game text calls these 'mobile dolls' (モビルドール).

entries.series: Mobile Suit Gundam Wing
entries.role: Prototype high-performance mobile suit (OZ-00MS), Zechs's machine
entries.notes: Wiki title 'OZ-00MS Tallgeese'. Avoid 'Tallgiese' or 'Torgis'.

entries.series: Mobile Suit Gundam Wing: Endless Waltz
entries.role: Final Tallgeese variant (OZ-00MS2B) with a Mega Cannon, piloted by Zechs in Endless Waltz
entries.notes: Wiki title 'OZ-00MS2B Tallgeese III'. The Roman numeral is written as ASCII 'III'.

entries.series: Mobile Suit Gundam Wing: Endless Waltz
entries.role: Mass-produced heavy-firepower mobile suit (MMS-01) of the Mariemaia Army
entries.notes: Wiki title 'MMS-01 Serpent'.

entries.series: Mobile Suit Gundam Wing: Endless Waltz
entries.role: Chang Wufei's Gundam (XXXG-01S2), Endless Waltz redesign of Altron Gundam; fought as an enemy in ACE2 mission m6093
entries.notes: Contested (Altron vs Nataku). The wiki page title is 'XXXG-01S2 Altron Gundam EW'. 'Gundam Nataku' redirects there, and the page lists 'Nataku' as an alias. Wufei named the machine after his late wife Meilan, whom he called Nataku. ACE2's visible text always uses ガンダムナタク ('Gundam Nataku', 'Gundam Nataku destroyed'), so keep 'Gundam Nataku' to match the game's naming. That is also the name used for the Endless Waltz-era model kits. Use 'Altron Gundam' only if the project prefers the wiki's page name over the game's name. アルトロン appears only in two internal ※ cue lines in m6093 (※VSアルトロン, ※アルトロン撤退), which refer to this same unit.

entries.ja: ウイングガンダムゼロ
entries.series: Mobile Suit Gundam Wing / Endless Waltz
entries.role: Heero's Gundam (XXXG-00W0) with the ZERO System and Twin Buster Rifle
entries.notes: Wiki title 'XXXG-00W0 Wing Gundam Zero'; aliases 'Wing Zero', 'Zero'. Game text has both ウイングガンダムゼロ and ウイングガンダムゼロ（ＥＷ版）.

entries.ja: ウイングガンダムゼロカスタム
entries.series: Mobile Suit Gundam Wing: Endless Waltz
entries.role: Endless Waltz redesign of Wing Gundam Zero with angel-like wings (Hajime Katoki design)
entries.notes: The wiki now titles this machine 'XXXG-00W0 Wing Gundam Zero EW' and has no 'Wing Gundam Zero Custom' page or redirect. 'Wing Gundam Zero Custom' is the long-standing official Bandai model-kit name (HG/PG 'Wing Gundam Zero Custom', shown in the wiki's Gunpla gallery). In the game it appears once, as ウィングガンダムゼロカスタム (small ィ), in menu3001. Elsewhere the game calls it ウイングガンダムゼロ（ＥＷ版） (see that entry). For a uniform roster, translate both as 'Wing Gundam Zero (EW)', or keep 'Custom' here to stay literal.

entries.ja: ウイングガンダムゼロ（ＥＷ版）
entries.series: Mobile Suit Gundam Wing: Endless Waltz
entries.role: Endless Waltz version of Wing Gundam Zero (Wing Zero Custom)
entries.notes: Found in the game text. The wiki suffixes EW designs with 'EW' (title 'XXXG-00W0 Wing Gundam Zero EW'). '(EW)' in parentheses mirrors the game's （ＥＷ版） = 'EW version'. 'Wing Gundam Zero (EW Ver.)' also works if space allows.

entries.ja: ガンダムデスサイズヘル
entries.series: Mobile Suit Gundam Wing / Endless Waltz
entries.role: Duo's upgraded Gundam (XXXG-01D2) with Active Cloak and Twin Beam Scythe
entries.notes: Wiki title 'XXXG-01D2 Gundam Deathscythe Hell'. Write 'Deathscythe' as one word ('Death Scythe' and 'Deathsythe' are wrong). Game also has ガンダムデスサイズヘル（ＥＷ版） = 'Gundam Deathscythe Hell (EW)' (wiki 'XXXG-01D2 Gundam Deathscythe Hell EW'; the old kit name is 'Deathscythe Hell Custom').

entries.ja: ガンダムデスサイズヘル（ＥＷ版）
entries.series: Mobile Suit Gundam Wing: Endless Waltz
entries.role: Endless Waltz version of Deathscythe Hell
entries.notes: Found in the game text. Wiki title 'XXXG-01D2 Gundam Deathscythe Hell EW'.

entries.ja: ガンダムヘビーアームズ
entries.series: Mobile Suit Gundam Wing / Endless Waltz
entries.role: Trowa's heavy-firepower Gundam (XXXG-01H)
entries.notes: Wiki title 'XXXG-01H Gundam Heavyarms'. Write 'Heavyarms' as one word ('Heavy Arms' is wrong). The upgrade is ヘビーアームズ改 = 'Gundam Heavyarms Custom' (wiki 'XXXG-01H2 Gundam Heavyarms Custom EW', aka 'Heavyarms Kai'). ACE2 does not use 改; its EW form is ガンダムヘビーアームズ（ＥＷ版）, so do not add 'Custom'.

entries.ja: ガンダムヘビーアームズ（ＥＷ版）
entries.series: Mobile Suit Gundam Wing: Endless Waltz
entries.role: Endless Waltz version of Heavyarms
entries.notes: Found in the game text. Literal 'Gundam Heavyarms (EW)'. The wiki has both 'XXXG-01H Gundam Heavyarms EW' (base) and 'XXXG-01H2 Gundam Heavyarms Custom EW' (the version actually used in the Endless Waltz finale). The game omits 改/Custom, so keep the literal form unless the model shown is clearly the Custom.

entries.ja: ガンダムサンドロック
entries.series: Mobile Suit Gundam Wing / Endless Waltz
entries.role: Quatre's desert-combat Gundam (XXXG-01SR) with Heat Shotels
entries.notes: Wiki title 'XXXG-01SR Gundam Sandrock'. The upgrade is サンドロック改 = 'Gundam Sandrock Custom' (aka 'Sandrock Kai'); ACE2 does not use 改. Quatre also says '僕のサンドロック' (my Sandrock).

entries.ja: ガンダムサンドロック（ＥＷ版）
entries.series: Mobile Suit Gundam Wing: Endless Waltz
entries.role: Endless Waltz version of Sandrock
entries.notes: Found in the game text. Same caveat as Heavyarms (EW): the wiki splits 'Gundam Sandrock EW' from 'Gundam Sandrock Custom EW'. The game omits 改/Custom, so the literal form is used here.

entries.series: Mobile Suit Gundam Wing
entries.role: Wufei's original Gundam (XXXG-01S), called Nataku by him
entries.notes: Wiki title 'XXXG-01S Shenlong Gundam'. Variants: 'Shen Long', 'Shenron'. Not found in the extracted ACE2 text (no シェンロン hits); ACE2 uses ガンダムナタク instead. Keep only as reference.

entries.series: Mobile Suit Gundam Wing / Endless Waltz
entries.role: Wufei's upgraded Gundam (XXXG-01S2); the same machine ACE2 calls Gundam Nataku
entries.notes: Wiki title 'XXXG-01S2 Altron Gundam' (TV) / 'XXXG-01S2 Altron Gundam EW'. The full アルトロンガンダム does not occur in the extracted ACE2 text. Only the short アルトロン appears, in two internal ※ cue lines in m6093 (※VSアルトロン, ※アルトロン撤退), which refer to the Gundam Nataku fight. If those lines are visible to the player, consider 'Nataku' for consistency. Variant: 'Nataku Gundam'.

entries.series: Mobile Fighter G Gundam
entries.role: Self-evolving, self-repairing, self-replicating rogue Gundam (JDG-00X); main antagonist machine of G Gundam
entries.notes: Wiki title 'JDG-00X Devil Gundam'. The US dub renamed it 'Dark Gundam' (the wiki redirects that name to this page). The original Japanese is literally 'Devil', so use 'Devil Gundam'. Appears often in the game text (17 files), including 'finish off the Devil Gundam in Meikyo Shisui mode'.

entries.series: Mobile Fighter G Gundam
entries.role: Domon's second Mobile Fighter (GF13-017NJII), Neo Japan; God Finger and Hyper Mode (Meikyo Shisui)
entries.notes: Wiki title 'GF13-017NJII God Gundam'. The US dub renamed it 'Burning Gundam' (also 'G Gundam'). Use the original 'God Gundam'. Appears in the game text.

entries.ja: シャイニングガンダム
entries.series: Mobile Fighter G Gundam
entries.role: Domon's first Mobile Fighter (GF13-017NJ), Neo Japan; Shining Finger
entries.notes: Wiki title 'GF13-017NJ Shining Gundam'. Not found in the extracted ACE2 text; kept as reference.

entries.series: Mobile Fighter G Gundam
entries.role: Master Asia's (Toho Fuhai) Mobile Fighter (GF13-001NHII), Neo Hong Kong
entries.notes: Wiki title 'GF13-001NHII Master Gundam'. Not found in the extracted ACE2 text; kept as reference. The game does contain the school name 流派東方不敗 (Toho Fuhai school; wiki uses 'Master Asia' for the person).

entries.series: Mobile Suit Gundam Wing: Endless Waltz
entries.role: Secret intelligence/peacekeeping organization of the Earth Sphere Unified Nation that stops conflicts before they escalate; in ACE2, an ally that releases material on the Guardian project and sends Noin and Heero
entries.notes: Wiki title 'Preventer' (singular; usually 'the Preventers' in English prose, and agents are 'Preventer Wind', 'Preventer Fire', etc.). The game uses it widely (39 files).

entries.series: Mobile Suit Gundam Wing
entries.role: Militant anti-Earth colony organization, later led by Zechs Merquise
entries.notes: Wiki title 'White Fang' (kanji field ホワイト・ファング). ACE2 has Zechs's line 今の私は、ホワイトファングの総帥だ ('Now I am the leader of the White Fang').

entries.series: Mobile Suit Gundam Wing: Endless Waltz
entries.role: Private army of Mariemaia Khushrenada, raised by the Barton Foundation to conquer the Earth Sphere (Endless Waltz antagonists)
entries.notes: Wiki title 'Mariemaia Army' (kanji field マリーメイア軍). Not found in the extracted ACE2 text as of this check, which may only reflect the files extracted so far.

entries.series: Mobile Suit Gundam Wing
entries.role: Organization of the Zodiac: elite secret society/military organization inside the Alliance, led by Treize Khushrenada
entries.notes: Wiki title 'Organization of the Zodiac'; 'OZ' redirects to it. The game writes it in full-width ＯＺ (e.g. 'the enemy is an OZ mobile doll unit', 'former OZ ace pilot'). Render as 'OZ' (all caps, no periods). Spell out 'Organization of the Zodiac' only where a gloss is needed.
